owner_authorization: Owner approves motions and acting but requests speed/pacing appropriate for click-to-move often lasting 1-2s. Prior source-first iterative generation authority remains; one revised take per mode.
parent_review_scope: Actual original-video technical verification, two independent still-frame reviews and root sampled playback, plus owner approval of acting and request for compact timing. No complete temporal checkpoint score.

input_selection.selection_source: actual native frame from available original Grok video; choose individually, not a compulsory old painting

candidate_video.motion_status: Owner approves slow acting direction; timing and loop/source acceptance remain open. Screen each candidate frame.

input_selection.transform: lossless native frame capture only; no crop, resize, repaint, composite, warping, still generation or optical flow

identity_reference.binding: bind if supported, otherwise record honestly as consulted

requested_settings.audio: request silent; preserve/disclose unavoidable original native audio
requested_settings.duration_fallback: Use shortest actual supported duration; put more natural middle cycles in longer video, never stretch start/stop or slow the cadence. Record actual settings.

performance_contract.timing: prompt times are approximate choreography; select actual windows after observing video
performance_contract.loop_boundary_test: pose plus incoming/outgoing motion for body, hands, tail/fin and hair
performance_contract.mode_distinction: compare slow and dash side by side at native 1x; dash stronger/quicker with meaningful launch/deceleration, not a time-scaled duplicate

gameplay_timing_targets_seconds.status: pilot targets, not measured/accepted source facts

performance_contract.controller_expectation: Immediate control response; START once then CRUISE repeated while moving; STOP on release/arrival without whole-clip/cycle lock. Source job must report exit phases; runtime/controller not implemented by this packet.
required_return_segment_evidence: actual natural loop range(s) and both-side pose/velocity evidence
actual stop range and departure phase

preserve: Owner-approved A001 movement/acting direction; fix pacing, not a redesign
right-facing presentation; left is a later display mirror
complete full-body framing and stable scale
connected expressive torso, bent arms, coherent buoyant curls, broad continuous fin
blocking_defects: fake duplicated cycles or failed actual cruise seam
slow/dash not distinct at native speed
Long theatrical preparation or braking mismatched to 1-2s travel
Whole-film duration mistaken for uninterruptible gameplay action
execution_note: One compact timing revision per mode, sequentially; check ACK/RETURN to avoid duplicates. Publish each native output/input/return. Then wait for addressed review. No automatic third same-method failed attempt.
on_missing_inputs_or_tools: Report precise blocker and empty media artifacts, not a new still or unapproved substitute mode/API purchase.

review_contract.score: lower unrounded mean >=4.8 with no blocking defects, then HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED per mode
review_contract.pair_review: distinct native-speed performances; no mode can compensate for failure of the other

generation_ready_reason: Authorized selection/generation job, but actual native IMAGE_1 not yet selected and screened; record selection before invoking video tool. No extra owner opening approval.
